name: propose_plan
title: propose_plan
description: Submit a step-by-step plan for human review before mutating the project. When plan approval is enabled, mutating tools are blocked until the human presses Approve Plan in the dock.

summary.description: One-paragraph overview of what you intend to build or change.

steps.description: Ordered list of concrete steps the human can review.

errors.missing_parameter: summary and steps are both required.
errors.plan_approval_required: Mutating tools are blocked until propose_plan is approved.
